name: Egypt Israeli Gas Import Pipeline (GASCO / Nitzana Egyptian section)

values.OtherEnglishNames: GASCO Nitzana line; Egyptian-side Nitzana gas import pipeline

researcher_notes: NEW ROW. Distinct physical pipe from the two Israeli-side rows already on the roster: P3620 (Israel–Egypt Onshore / Ramat Hovav–Nitzana, 65 km, INGL/Chevron) and P7864 (Nitzana Pipeline, 65 km, the same Israeli 65 km line). This candidate is the EGYPTIAN-side line, built/overseen by GASCO (Egyptian Natural Gas Co), a separate ~$400M investment entirely inside Egypt that connects the Nitzana border crossing to the Egyptian national grid to receive the expanded NewMed/Leviathan (Phase 1B) volumes. Owner reuses the existing GEM entity 'Egyptian Natural Gas Co' (entity_lookup match 93) rather than creating a duplicate. Add-threshold met on all three legs: (a) sponsor = GASCO / Egyptian government; (b) country=Egypt + endpoint=Nitzana border crossing; (c) concrete step = firm $400M investment commitment, construction planned Q4 2025 (New Arab), tied to Chevron/INGL FID on the Israeli side. Corroboration: New Arab (Sep 2025), JPT/SPE (Sep 2025), and Pipeline Technology Journal (Sep 2025) independently report the distinct Egyptian $400M GASCO line; throughput ~6 bcm/y (~600 MMcf/d), completion 2028. All URLs pass url_verifier (substrings: '400', 'GASCO'/'Gasco', 'Nitzana', 'billion cubic'). CONFIDENCE = medium: existence/sponsor/cost solidly triangulated across 2+ independent outlets, but they trace largely to the Sep 2025 announcement window and detailed specs are thin — LENGTH, DIAMETER, and precise Egyptian endpoint are NOT reported (the '65 km' figure belongs to the Israeli side; do NOT copy it here), so those columns are left blank. Status held at 'proposed' (skeptical default): Q4-2025 construction was planned but no independent source confirms Egyptian-side groundbreaking; upgrade to 'construction' when confirmed. ROUTE: no official GIS; only the Nitzana border entry point is known, destination into the grid (likely toward North Sinai/El Arish) unconfirmed — RouteAccuracy=unknown, no route staged, no coords fabricated. Excluded attaqa.net evidence URL: it is a date-index page that has since rolled over to unrelated Jul-2026 content and no longer carries the pipeline article, so it is not a stable citation.
